title: File:Magenta Live at Trading Boundaries, Sussex, 21st October 2022.jpg
desc:
Magenta are a Welsh progressive rock band formed in 1999 by ex-Cyan member Rob Reed. The current line up is:
Christina Booth: lead vocals.
Rob Reed: keyboards, backing vocals.
Chris Fry: lead electric guitars, backing vocals.
Dan Nelson: bass.
'Jiffy' Griffiths: drums.
Peter Jones (Camel / Tiger Mot
